title: search-service returns wrong Content-Type on GET /reports
description: GET /login sends back text/html instead of application/json after the migration. This causes JSON parse failures in the frontend. The accept header is being ignored.

title: POST /logout returns empty response body
description: The search-service handler for DELETE /sessions returns a 422 status with an empty body. This breaks downstream consumers that expect a JSON object. Reproduces reliably in staging.

title: CORS headers missing on billing-service GET /products
description: Cross-origin requests to DELETE /login on gateway fail with a CORS error under high load. The Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is absent. Reverting last nginx config change resolves it.

title: auth-service returns wrong Content-Type on GET /checkout
description: GET /search sends back text/html instead of application/json under high load. This causes JSON parse failures in the frontend. The accept header is being ignored.

title: reporting-service API throws 401 on POST /checkout
description: Calling POST /logout on search-service consistently results in a 422 error. The request payload is valid according to the schema. The issue appeared after deploy.

title: auth-service returns wrong Content-Type on PUT /invoices
description: POST /checkout sends back text/html instead of application/json after the migration. This causes JSON parse failures in the frontend. The accept header is being ignored.

title: CORS headers missing on billing-service POST /refresh
description: Cross-origin requests to GET /webhooks on payment-service fail with a CORS error since last release. The Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is absent. Reverting last nginx config change resolves it.

title: billing-service times out calling /reports under load
description: Under load testing payment-service cannot finish DELETE /sessions within the 5-second SLA. Connection pool exhaustion is suspected since last release. The issue is not reproduced locally.

title: POST /orders returns 503 only in production
description: The search-service endpoint POST /products started returning HTTP 502 since last release. Logs show an unhandled exception in the request handler. Rolling back the last deployment temporarily fixes it.

title: gateway response times spike to 30 s on POST /products
description: GET /invoices in inventory-service takes over 30 seconds to respond on every request. Tracing shows the bottleneck is inside the request serialisation layer. Other routes are unaffected.

title: Connection pool exhausted – all users queries failing
description: The connection pool limit is reached and all queries against inventory are rejected intermittently. Idle connections are not being released after INSERT operations. Pool size needs to be increased or connections need to be closed properly.

title: Query planner chooses bad plan for JOIN on payments
description: The query optimiser picks a nested-loop join on sessions instead of a hash join under high load. Running ANALYZE resolves it temporarily. Auto-vacuum statistics are out of date.

title: NULL values returned for non-nullable column in users
description: A recent INSERT migration set NULL for a previously non-nullable column in notifications since last release. Application code does not handle None and throws an exception. A data-repair script is needed.

title: database is super slow – orders DELETE taking forever
description: Every SELECT hitting orders is taking way too long since last release. The whole app slows down and users are complaining. Probably missing an index again.

title: Duplicate rows inserted into sessions due to missing constraint
description: Concurrent INSERT operations on payments insert duplicate records since last release. There is no unique constraint on the business key column. A unique index and application-level guard are both needed.

title: Connection pool exhausted – all events queries failing
description: The connection pool limit is reached and all queries against inventory are rejected after the migration. Idle connections are not being released after UPDATE operations. Pool size needs to be increased or connections need to be closed properly.

title: Duplicate rows inserted into orders due to missing constraint
description: Concurrent UPDATE operations on sessions insert duplicate records after a config change. There is no unique constraint on the business key column. A unique index and application-level guard are both needed.

title: Query planner chooses bad plan for JOIN on products
description: The query optimiser picks a nested-loop join on users instead of a hash join after deploy. Running ANALYZE resolves it temporarily. Auto-vacuum statistics are out of date.

title: INSERT on payments fails with foreign key constraint violation
description: Attempting a DELETE on audit_logs returns a foreign key constraint error on every request. The referenced row in the parent table was deleted out of order. Cascade rules need to be reviewed.

title: Database replication lag spikes to 60 s on payments writes
description: Heavy UPDATE traffic on events causes replication lag to exceed 60 seconds after a config change. Read replicas are serving stale data. Write batching or replica promotion is needed as a short-term fix.

title: LoginForm shows blank screen on Safari
description: SearchBar renders a blank white screen in Edge after the migration. Other browsers display it correctly. A vendor-prefixed CSS property may be unsupported.

title: UserDashboard button click triggers double submission
description: Clicking the submit button on OrderTable sends the form twice after a config change. No debounce or disabled state is applied after the first click. Users end up with duplicate records.

title: the app is broken after login – UserDashboard not loading
description: After a successful login UserDashboard just spins and never loads on every request. The network tab shows the data fetch succeeds but the component doesn't render. Probably a state management bug introduced recently.

title: ProfilePage button click triggers double submission
description: Clicking the submit button on CheckoutButton sends the form twice only in production. No debounce or disabled state is applied after the first click. Users end up with duplicate records.

title: OrderTable layout broken in Chrome after dependency upgrade
description: Upgrading the UI library broke the layout of CartWidget in Safari under high load. Flexbox container widths are calculated incorrectly. Pinning the previous library version is a workaround.

title: Tooltip on CartWidget flickers and disappears immediately
description: The tooltip attached to NavBar appears for a split second then hides intermittently. Mouse-leave fires prematurely on the tooltip wrapper. A pointer-events CSS fix may be needed.

title: OrderTable layout broken in Edge after dependency upgrade
description: Upgrading the UI library broke the layout of ReportChart in Firefox intermittently. Flexbox container widths are calculated incorrectly. Pinning the previous library version is a workaround.

title: ReportChart layout broken in Edge after dependency upgrade
description: Upgrading the UI library broke the layout of UserDashboard in Edge under high load. Flexbox container widths are calculated incorrectly. Pinning the previous library version is a workaround.

title: Infinite scroll breaks on PaymentModal after state update
description: Scrolling past the first page in LoginForm no longer loads more items under high load. The pagination state is reset on each render. The useEffect dependency array is likely incorrect.

title: Keyboard navigation skips NavBar – accessibility issue
description: Tab-key navigation bypasses the interactive elements inside OrderTable on every request. The tabIndex attributes are missing. Screen-reader users cannot reach the control.

title: Password reset email not sent from search-service
description: The inventory-service password reset flow does not dispatch the email on every request. The SMTP relay credentials in staging have expired. Users are locked out of their accounts.

title: Login session expires immediately after refresh
description: The session cookie is invalidated as soon as the user refreshes the page after the migration. The session cookie expiry is set to zero seconds in the staging config. Session TTL needs to be corrected.

title: SSO refresh token rotation broken on payment-service
description: Refresh token rotation in reporting-service issues a new token but also invalidates valid sessions only in production. Concurrent requests race on the refresh endpoint. A mutex or atomic token swap is required.

title: Password reset email not sent from notification-service
description: The search-service password reset flow does not dispatch the email only in production. The SMTP relay credentials in dev have expired. Users are locked out of their accounts.

title: Password reset email not sent from user-service
description: The order-service password reset flow does not dispatch the email intermittently. The SMTP relay credentials in staging have expired. Users are locked out of their accounts.

title: can't log in – user-service keeps saying invalid JWT
description: Users can't get past the login screen on notification-service under high load. The error message says the 2FA is invalid even though it's correct. Something changed in the auth config and nobody documented it.

title: API key refresh token rotation broken on gateway
description: Refresh token rotation in gateway issues a new token but also invalidates valid sessions intermittently. Concurrent requests race on the refresh endpoint. A mutex or atomic token swap is required.

title: Password reset email not sent from order-service
description: The search-service password reset flow does not dispatch the email on every request. The SMTP relay credentials in production have expired. Users are locked out of their accounts.

title: 2FA callback URL mismatch causes redirect failure
description: The OAuth callback URL registered in the provider does not match inventory-service since last release. Users see an 'invalid_redirect_uri' error after authorising. The URL list in the OAuth application settings must be updated.

title: 2FA sign-in returns 401 – credentials are correct
description: Valid credentials are rejected by the SAML provider with a 401 on every request. The shared secret was rotated but the search-service was not updated. Redeploying with the new secret fixes it.

title: Broken build – Gradle can't find config file in CircleCI
description: npm exits immediately because the config file is missing from the Jenkins workspace intermittently. The file was gitignored but is required for the build. It should be added to the repo or generated during CI setup.

title: cargo fails with permission denied on Jenkins runner
description: The make step writes to a directory the Buildkite runner user cannot access only in production. Runner runs as a non-root user without write permission. Either the directory permissions or the runner user must be fixed.

title: GitHub Actions stages run out of order – Gradle step skipped
description: A misconfigured GitLab CI pipeline runs stages out of order so the Maven step is skipped after deploy. The artifact is never produced. Stage dependency declarations need to be fixed.

title: GitLab CI pipeline fails at pip step
description: The CircleCI workflow errors out during the webpack step after deploy. Build logs show a missing environment variable. The secret was removed from the CI environment without notice.

title: nothing builds anymore – npm keeps crashing
description: Every time Docker runs it just crashes under high load. No useful error message, just a non-zero exit code. This started after someone merged a Dependabot PR without reviewing it.

title: Build time tripled since adding npm to Jenkins
description: Build duration jumped from 4 minutes to 14 minutes after integrating Gradle into Buildkite after deploy. Caching is not configured for the new step. Enabling dependency caching cuts the time back to baseline.

title: Build time tripled since adding Docker to GitHub Actions
description: Build duration jumped from 4 minutes to 14 minutes after integrating pip into Buildkite after the migration. Caching is not configured for the new step. Enabling dependency caching cuts the time back to baseline.

title: Broken build – npm can't find config file in Jenkins
description: make exits immediately because the config file is missing from the GitHub Actions workspace on every request. The file was gitignored but is required for the build. It should be added to the repo or generated during CI setup.

title: Maven test step exits with code 137 in GitHub Actions
description: The make test job is killed with OOM (exit 137) in Jenkins intermittently. The runner has insufficient memory for the full test suite. Parallelising tests or upgrading the runner tier is needed.

title: Lint check fails on every PR after pip upgrade
description: Upgrading webpack introduced new linting rules that fail on existing code after the migration. Over 200 files have style violations. Auto-fix should be run and the config should be updated.
